ก.text: This letter is Gor Gai. It makes a sound between g and k. The picture word means chicken.

ข.text: This letter is Khor Khai. It makes the sound at the start of kite, with a puff of air. The picture word means egg.

ค.text: This letter is Khor Khwai. It makes the sound at the start of kite, with a puff of air. The picture word means buffalo.

ง.text: This letter is Ngor Ngu. It makes the sound at the end of sing. The picture word means snake.

จ.text: This letter is Jor Jan. It makes the sound at the start of jam, but softer. The picture word means plate.

ช.text: This letter is Chor Chang. It makes the sound at the start of chair. The picture word means elephant.

ด.text: This letter is Dor Dek. It makes the sound at the start of dog. The picture word means child.

ต.text: This letter is Dtor Dtao. It makes a sound between d and t. The picture word means turtle.

น.text: This letter is Nor Nu. It makes the sound at the start of nest. The picture word means mouse.

บ.text: This letter is Bor Baimai. It makes the sound at the start of bear. The picture word means leaf.

ป.text: This letter is Bpor Bpla. It makes a sound between b and p. The picture word means fish.

พ.text: This letter is Phor Phan. It makes the sound at the start of pig, with a puff of air. The picture word means offering tray.

ฟ.text: This letter is For Fan. It makes the sound at the start of fish. The picture word means tooth.

ม.text: This letter is Mor Ma. It makes the sound at the start of moon. The picture word means horse.

ย.text: This letter is Yor Yak. It makes the sound at the start of yellow. The picture word means giant.

ร.text: This letter is Ror Ruea. It makes a rolled r. The picture word means boat.

ล.text: This letter is Lor Ling. It makes the sound at the start of lion. The picture word means monkey.

ว.text: This letter is Wor Waen. It makes the sound at the start of whale. The picture word means ring.

ส.text: This letter is Sor Suea. It makes the sound at the start of sun. The picture word means tiger.

ห.text: This letter is Hor Hip. It makes the sound at the start of hat. The picture word means chest.

อ.text: This letter is Or Ang. A vowel holder. Here it says ah. The picture word means basin.
